correctness.rationale: On coordinates centered at L/2 take the odd half-density w on [0,L/2], with the reset on the positive side at d=|x₀−L/2|. It has source r/2 at d, w(0)=0 and Dw′(L/2)+2κw(L/2)=0, with J=2κw(L/2). Testing against sinh(√(r/D)x) and integrating the Wronskian gives J=κr sinh(√(r/D)d)/(D√(r/D) cosh z+2κ sinh z). The other source side reverses the sign, and the flux boundary conditions imply mass one on integrating the full equation. For the given profile, log of z sinh(uz)/sinh z has second derivative strictly negative by sinh(uz)<u sinh z. The denominator coth z+k/z of the remaining factor is a sum of positive log-convex functions. Thus the log slope H decreases strictly, and the flux tends to zero at both ends for 0<u<1. H_u and H_k are positive by sinh v cosh v>v, so the unique optimizer moves upward in u and k. In the near-membrane scaling δ=2ℓ/L, y=δz, η_ℓ=δk, H/δ tends to 2/y−1−1/(y+η), locally uniformly in y even for η→∞ with the last term tending to zero. The limit is strictly decreasing and changes sign at G(η); bracketing traps the true optimizer, so r_*ℓ²/D→G(η)² with endpoints 1 and 4. All these conclusions use fixed κ when varying r; log-concavity is in z, not asserted in r.
residual_risks: A midpoint reset produces zero flux and is excluded. No extension to general reset distributions or multiple membranes was tested. Diagnostic grids were not used as proofs.

originality.rationale: The forward stationary current is demonstrably covered, including as an exact point-mass specialization of the arbitrary-law tomography formula. The supported distinct claim is the global clock optimization of absolute stationary flux: strict log-concavity, strict parameter shifts and the entire near-contact crossover. The entropy optimizer records vary permeability or concern entropy rather than this current; the related biased-membrane theorem seeks a zero of signed current, not a maximum of its magnitude. No inspected claim or stronger theorem establishes the optimization package.
residual_risks: Unindexed analyses of the same known current formula could overlap. The verdict credits forward formula identity and does not certify publication priority.

value.rationale: For a natural driven stationary model the result identifies the unique throughput-maximizing clock, determines how it moves with two physical controls, and gives an arbitrary-family scaling law when proximity and contact strength compete. In particular the factor-four difference between the limiting clock scales is quantitative information absent from a statement that flux merely vanishes at both extremes. The current objective is distinct from dissipation and first-passage time.
residual_risks: An ideal stationary probability current, not a calibrated transport-device performance measure; the asymptotic comparison does not interchange arbitrary endpoint and rate limits.
